title: Router: local Coder runs carry frozen check suites so terminal routes can end verified
body: Follow-up of #10207 (part of #10204). Phase 1 routes every terminal/CLI message through route-contract, but local runs (task::autostart grant, `requirements: None`) have no frozen independent check suites, so a live terminal Coder route projects `completed/unchecked`, never `verified`. The phase 1 fixtures prove the verified path through the task owner with requirements; this issue is to give local runs a checker (or the issue gate's) so the route record's check label is `verified` on real work. See docs/api/2026-10-02-agentic-execution-router.md, phase 1 exit evidence, 'What phase 1 does not do yet'.
